items.en: Ukraine's Patriot interceptor shortage deepens: Berlin says no more Patriots for now, Kyiv wants Russia's missiles stopped at the factory through sanctions, Romania reopens SkyCeptor talks with Rafael, Spain pledges an unspecified €437 million package, and Finland urges the US to release already-paid missiles

items.sEn: German Defence Minister Boris Pistorius told the Berliner Morgenpost that Germany has, for now, "exhausted its capabilities" to supply Patriot systems.
